Q1: 1-Decene is associated with known hazards (Tier 1) for environmental, inhalation, and oral exposures based on GHS classifications. Expanded perspectives (Tier 2) indicate potential carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive, dermal, and eye hazards, while organ and systemic hazards are data deficient (Tier 4).
Q2: 1-Decene does not appear on any official Lists of Concern or Lists of Low Hazard.
Q3: With 10,000 scientific literature references and a well-defined molecular structure, 1-Decene appears broadly characterized. However, its hazard profile has significant gaps, lacking formal EPA evaluations (IRIS/PPRTV), having no recorded toxicity values in ToxValDB, and showing data deficiency for organ and systemic hazards.
